name: Predicted-region value-role adapter
motivation: Prior region attention-mass biases and pooled regional readouts failed to improve sequence-level Dice. This candidate leaves native attention assignment unchanged and adds bounded, zero-initialized role embeddings only to spatial memory values.
method: For each of SAM2's four memory-attention layers, add a learned foreground, mixed-boundary, or background role vector to each spatial value token. Bound each channel's offset to 0.1 times that channel's spatial-value RMS. Keep queries, keys, attention probabilities, object-pointer keys/values, all spatial tokens, memory writes, image encoder, decoder, and frame schedule unchanged.

prior_work.adaptation: RMNet uses mask-defined regional memory and applies mask-derived modulation to memory keys and values. This SAM2 adaptation uses the checked-out project's predicted-mask region assignments and applies bounded additive role embeddings to value tokens only; it does not import RMNet's optical-flow ROI tracking or replace SAM2 attention.
prior_work.MMN_code_status: No official public repository was located during this survey; no MMN implementation is claimed.

model.initialization: All role vectors zero; output must be bit-identical to native attention.

data.scope: Exploratory only: PolypGen informed earlier analyses and candidate design; patient-to-sequence independence is unverified.

training.loss: Mean author-compatible post-prompt decoder BCE plus Dice mask loss and object-presence loss across sampled clips.

evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice over seq16-seq23.
evaluation.success_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice over native, higher Dice on at least 6/8 sequences, and no increase in pooled false alarms on GT-empty frames.
evaluation.interpretation: One seed is a screening experiment, not reliable confirmation. A positive result requires a second pre-specified seed and an untouched external dataset before a general performance claim.
